# IndeXOS

> IndeXOS is a Linux-based phone OS in pre-alpha where the whole interface is a `.hui` theme. Built by J.B.

## Pages
- Overview: https://halo-eap.github.io/index-os-preview/
- About: https://halo-eap.github.io/index-os-preview/about.html
- Roadmap: https://halo-eap.github.io/index-os-preview/roadmap.html
- Download: https://halo-eap.github.io/index-os-preview/download.html

## What works today
- Theme format 6: manifest, profile and assets in one `.hui` archive, with separate element sets for the phone, desktop and tablet surfaces.
- Loader with validation, clamping, atomic install and rollback to the previous theme.
- Designer for Windows (source build): live phone, desktop and tablet preview, saves `.hui`.
- Qt/QML shell: draws the three surfaces, clickable icons, app windows, start menu, runtime surface switch. Runs on a PC.
- Dock detection on Linux: reads USB and display state and records which surface to draw.

## Not built yet
- The bootable OS image, the Windows and Android app runtimes, third-party app theming, the Workshop and community store, and all hardware.

## Ecosystem
- **IndeXOS**: Core operating system layer and user interface.
- **IndeX Phone**: Custom hardware target running native .exe binaries and .hui layout files.
- **CoolDock**: Active thermal management and expansion dock.
- **Halet**: Portable companion ecosystem interface.
- **TV Dock**: Desktop display output dock.

## Distribution
The OS image is not public and is not planned to be. The theme format and the Designer are shared so themes can be made and tested.
